scripts.locust:up: docker compose -f microservices/docker-compose.yml -f locust/docker-compose.locust.yml up -d --build --scale locust-worker=4
scripts.locust:open: node -e "console.log('Locust UI: http://localhost:8089 (run npm run locust:up first)')"
scripts.locust:smoke: docker compose -f microservices/docker-compose.yml -f locust/docker-compose.locust.yml run --rm locust-master -f /mnt/locust/locustfile.py,/mnt/locust/shapes/smoke.py --host=http://gateway:4000 --headless --only-summary --csv=/mnt/locust/reports/smoke --html=/mnt/locust/reports/smoke.html --logfile=/mnt/locust/reports/smoke.log --processes 4
scripts.locust:normal: docker compose -f microservices/docker-compose.yml -f locust/docker-compose.locust.yml run --rm locust-master -f /mnt/locust/locustfile.py,/mnt/locust/shapes/normal.py --host=http://gateway:4000 --headless --only-summary --csv=/mnt/locust/reports/normal --html=/mnt/locust/reports/normal.html --logfile=/mnt/locust/reports/normal.log --processes 4
